def build_module_stubs(entries: Iterable[FunctionDefinition]) ->Dict[str,
    ModuleStub]:
    module_to_defs: DefaultDict[str, List[FunctionDefinition]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for entry in entries:
        module_to_defs[entry.module].append(entry)
    
    result: Dict[str, ModuleStub] = {}
    for module_name, defns in module_to_defs.items():
        # Collect all function definitions and their typed dict stubs
        function_stubs: List[FunctionStub] = []
        typed_dict_class_stubs: List[ClassStub] = []
        imports: ImportMap = ImportMap()
        
        for defn in defns:
            # Create function stub
            func_stub = FunctionStub(
                name=defn.qualname.split(".")[-1],
                signature=defn.signature,
                kind=defn.kind,
                is_async=defn.is_async
            )
            function_stubs.append(func_stub)
            
            # Collect imports from the signature
            sig_imports = get_imports_for_signature(defn.signature)
            imports.merge(sig_imports)
            
            # Collect typed dict class stubs
            typed_dict_class_stubs.extend(defn.typed_dict_class_stubs)
        
        # Create imports stub
        imports_stub = ImportBlockStub(imports)
        
        # Create module stub
        module_stub = ModuleStub(
            function_stubs=function_stubs,
            typed_dict_class_stubs=typed_dict_class_stubs,
            imports_stub=imports_stub
        )
        
        result[module_name] = module_stub
    
    return result
